abstract: Turns a script with [bracket] editor cues into a finished 9:16 avatar reel: HeyGen avatar generation by name, local word-level Whisper timestamps (Fish Audio optional), cue-to-timestamp mapping with an approval gate, Remotion kinetic captions/title cards/stat callouts with selectable dark/light/punch templates and configurable avatar framing, and FFmpeg dead-air trimming, SFX/music mixing and export.
